data.summary: The pod startup was delayed primarily by a slow image pull, which took 28.7 seconds for a 53 MB image. The observed pull throughput of 1.9 MB/s is significantly below the 5 MB/s threshold, indicating a bottleneck in the registry or network path.

findings.statement: The image_pull phase lasted 28.724 seconds, which accounts for the majority of the 30.0-second total startup time.
The image pull throughput was 1.9 MB/s (1,856,598 bytes/s), which is well below the 5 MB/s threshold for healthy performance.

ruled_out.reason: The image size is only 53 MB, which is relatively small and should not cause a 28.7-second pull time under normal network conditions.
The scheduling phase duration was 0.0 seconds, indicating no delay in pod placement.

recommendations.rationale: This ensures the image is already present on nodes before the pod is scheduled, bypassing registry throughput issues during scale-up.

recommendations.action: Investigate the registry or network path for bottlenecks, rate limiting, or the need for a local pull-through cache
